title: Magnetic button
description: A gentle pull toward the pointer, followed by a spring back to rest.
useCase: Add a tactile response to an occasional, prominent action. Keep everyday navigation stationary.
interaction: Move your pointer over the button
reducedMotion: The button remains stationary; its ordinary interaction still works.
limitations: Pointer attraction is an enhancement for a mouse or trackpad. Touch and keyboard use the standard button.
look: Warm off-white page with a single dark charcoal pill button holding white sans-serif text and a thin arrow icon.
motion: A mouse near the button pulls it toward the pointer (up to 28% of offset, zero beyond 160 px) on a spring; leaving springs it back; pressing scales to 0.97.
adapt: Pull is computed in `move`: `strength` falls off over `160` px with a `0.28` cap, feeding `x` and `y`; `useSpring` (`stiffness: 180, damping: 18, mass: 0.3`) smooths it and `whileTap` scales to `0.97`. Replace the label, icon and `joined` toggle.
